tags.label: sports participation
tags.definition: Numbers and characteristics of people taking part in sporting events, training or organised sporting activities.
includes: Entrants and participants by sport, event, age or sex; active sporting participation and training.
excludes: Competitive results and performance records alone; inventories of sporting venues or organisations without participation measures.

tags.label: hunting
tags.definition: Hunting activity and its regulation, including hunting licences issued for recreational, commercial or scientific purposes.
includes: Hunting licences, game hunting, hunting returns and hunting-management measures.
excludes: Fishing licences; general firearm permits without a hunting subject; wildlife censuses without hunting or game-management content.

tags.label: economic indicators
tags.definition: Broad summaries or index sets combining several economic domains to describe general economic conditions.
includes: Economic barometers combining prices, production, trade, freight, banking, currency or securities indices.
excludes: Single-sector production, price, wage or living-cost series; policy and plans without an indicator summary.

tags.label: welfare institutions
tags.definition: General inventories of public, private or mixed social-work institutions, facilities and coordinating bodies across welfare functions.
includes: Multi-category censuses of child protection, economic protection, employment relief, poor relief, medical protection and aftercare facilities.
excludes: Commercial institutions without a welfare function; a table devoted solely to a specific welfare activity or charitable body when a more specific tag fits.
